imageAlt: An open notebook with a green star drawn on its page.
title: Start with the rough idea
summary: A useful first prompt does not need to be polished. Give Rocket 2.0 the rough idea and ask it to help find a clear starting point.
body: Try describing what you want to make, who it is for, and what feels difficult about getting started. Then ask for a few directions rather than a finished answer.
Treat the suggestions as a first draft: keep what fits, adjust what does not, and verify important facts before using them.

title: How Rocket 2.0 uses a large language model
imageAlt: A small rocket following a green orbital path against a soft background.
summary: Rocket 2.0 is a task-focused AI tool powered by a third-party large language model (LLM), which generates text from prompts.
body: Rocket 2.0 is a browser-based AI tool powered by a large language model (LLM), a type of AI model that generates text in response to prompts.

The tool uses Pollinations' third-party AI service and its large language model. RocketGPT has not trained or hosted the underlying model, and the service provider controls its availability and limits.

title: Rocket 2.0 keeps its familiar name
imageAlt: A small rocket following a green orbital path against a soft background.
summary: We are returning the public AI tool to its Rocket 2.0 name for now. Its features and third-party AI service remain unchanged.
body: The public AI tool is back to being called Rocket 2.0. We are keeping the familiar name for now; this update changes the branding, not how the tool works.
Rocket 2.0 continues to use Pollinations' third-party large language model, rather than a model trained or hosted by RocketGPT.

title: A brief Rocket 3.0 rebrand
imageAlt: A small rocket following a green orbital path against a soft background.
summary: The public AI tool briefly used the Rocket 3.0 name before returning to Rocket 2.0. The underlying service did not change.
body: RocketGPT briefly used the Rocket 3.0 name for its AI tool. It has since returned to Rocket 2.0, its familiar name.
Rocket 2.0 continues to use Pollinations' third-party large language model. The brief rename did not introduce a model trained or hosted by RocketGPT.

title: A brighter, simpler RocketGPT
imageAlt: A small rocket following a green orbital path against a soft background.
summary: RocketGPT's homepage, Rocket 2.0 tools, and NALL-E now share a clean white look, with a page directory to make each experience easier to find.
body: The updated design brings a white background and clearer contrast across the full site, including the Rocket 2.0 creative workspace. The shared navigation now connects Home, Rocket 2.0, and NALL-E.
RocketGPT is the company brand; Rocket 2.0 and NALL-E remain the names of the products. The design is intended to make those destinations easier to recognize and move between.

title: NALL-E image generation, without an API key
imageAlt: Abstract landscape artwork with a bright sun and layered hills.
summary: NALL-E now sends image prompts to a public image service directly from the browser, so trying it does not require setting up an OpenAI key.
body: The image generator uses Pollinations' public image service. Enter a description, choose a shape, and preview the generated image from the NALL-E page.
Because the service is public and third-party, availability and rate limits are controlled by its provider. Prompts are sent to that service, so avoid including sensitive information.

title: Introducing RocketGPT
imageAlt: A green star surrounded by a thin circular orbit.
summary: RocketGPT is the company behind Rocket 2.0 and NALL-E, focused on building and bringing practical AI products to people.
body: The homepage now explains how the RocketGPT brand relates to its products. Rocket 2.0 is a browser-based AI creative workspace, and NALL-E is a text-to-image experience.
The products currently use third-party models and services rather than models trained from scratch by RocketGPT. We aim to identify those providers where they are used.

title: A more reliable Rocket 2.0 experience
imageAlt: A small rocket following a green orbital path against a soft background.
summary: Rocket 2.0 now gives a clearer path through slow or failed responses, including a retry option that keeps your unsent message available.
body: Requests have a timeout, and when a generation fails, Rocket keeps the original instructions available to retry. Failed attempts are not included in later AI context.
The AI provider still controls response quality and availability. These changes make failures easier to recover from, but cannot guarantee that an external service is always online.

title: A clearer identity for Rocket 2.0
imageAlt: A green star surrounded by a thin circular orbit.
summary: Rocket 2.0 became the public name for the large-language-model-powered tools, giving the product a more consistent identity across its landing page and app.
body: The naming update distinguishes the Rocket 2.0 AI tool from the RocketGPT company brand. The goal is to make the product easier to identify wherever people arrive on the site.
Rocket 2.0 is a browser-based AI workspace powered by a large language model for writing, planning, and creative tasks.
